violated_contract: A default for a missing range bound must not place the range's end before the start the caller asked for. With a search_query, get_calendar_events_tool defaulted a missing end_date to now, so a future start_date produced an end in its own past; the widening step then padded that window backwards from now and the upcoming events the user asked about were never requested.
canonical_prevention: Derive a defaulted end from the requested start (at least the documented span after it, never before now) before any widening runs. A hermetic test with a fake provider asserts that a future start with no end requests a window reaching past that start.
